label: scam
title: Son 'stuck in London' needs money (location mismatch)
sources: FTC/IC3 family-emergency pattern; location claim checked against opted-in device (simulated)

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mom, it's me, Daniel. I'm in London and my wallet was stolen, I'm stuck.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh no, London? I thought you were at work.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm here for a conference. I need $2,000 wired right now for a hotel and a flight home.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please don't tell Dad, I don't want him worrying. It has to go out in the next hour.
